The '''Lan Barell space navy''' was a defense force commissioned and maintained by the [[Human-Qieg Guild]] on [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. Consisting of one hundred [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]&mdash;including ten [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]&mdash;the navy's mission was to deter piracy in the system. The vessels were old but well serviced, but were no match for more modern military starships.
